env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: The agent first extracts model requirements from configuration files, checkpoint metadata, model source code, and reference implementations. It then searches the target framework and reference repositories for adapters, registries, operator dispatch tables, kernel bindings, fallback rules, build flags, and tests.
env_context_strategy.note: Multi-valued list used though dimension is single; primary value agent_driven_navigation.

observation_format.evidence_quote: build logs, import failures, minimal serving runs, golden cases, and profiles update edge status and cost

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: the agent proposes minimal graph edits as code or configuration patches
edit_primitive.note: Paper describes patch sets (adapter/runtime/kernel/config) without specifying edit syntax; closest value chosen.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: MetaInfer implements each adaptation episode as three connected loops.
loop_primitives.note: Three-stage pipeline (graph construction, route restoration, cost reduction); patch-validate-repair loop; search tree with rollback: 'Executing an action expands the search tree and updates the graph'.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: the graph is not a retrospective drawing, but the control state that determines the next search, patch, and validation step
planning_granularity.note: The costed execution-adaptation graph plus the resource-aware planner's staged plan serve as an explicit stored plan object.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: Graph builder ... Migration agent ... Validation framework ... Resource-aware planner ... Profiling agent ... Kernel agent
multi_agent_topology.note: Specialised components/agents hand off inputs and outputs in a staged sequence.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: Profiling agent Serving execution Bottleneck report Kernel agent Bottleneck, shapes Guarded dispatch patch
delegation_mechanism.note: Inferred from component interface table; no explicit spawn mechanism described.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: Policy choices that cannot be settled by execution, such as target SLOs or acceptable numerical tolerance, are treated as external constraints.
human_in_loop.note: No human approval gate described in the loop; humans only set external constraints.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: A search node is ni = (Gi,∆ i,E i,B i),
short_term_state.note: Typed state: graph, patch set, evidence, remaining budget.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: A successful adaptation episode produces a transferable knowledge package
long_term_memory.note: Cross-episode knowledge package reused to initialize the next target graph; closest value is episodic_db (also resembles skill_library).

state_persistence.evidence_quote: MetaInfer therefore stores graph snapshots or graph deltas inside a bounded search process.
state_persistence.note: Snapshots used for rollback to nearest stable graph snapshot; resumption of interrupted runs not stated.

self_verification.evidence_quote: A patch enters an expensive stage only after passing cheaper compilation, loading, operator coverage, and numerical checks.
self_verification.note: Harness-run staged validation (builds, golden cases, serving runs, profiling); self_critique from 'revise hypotheses after failures'.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: Code search, log attribution, local build repair, and single-device golden cases can receive several automatic attempts because feedback is cheap and precise.
retry_policy.note: Budgeted retries until validation passes; no fixed N given.

rollback.evidence_quote: the search tree can roll back to the nearest stable graph snapshot

termination_condition.evidence_quote: Bi is the remaining resource budget
termination_condition.note: Budget-bounded search ('The inner loop is budgeted rather than open-ended'); completion when coverage invariant satisfied. Exact termination mechanics not specified.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: The search costc search captures the resources consumed by an agent action, such as tokens, builds, device runs, and elapsed time. Search cost is used by the resource-aware planner

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: The resource-aware planner expands validation from a single device to single-node multi-device and then to full service configurations.
execution_isolation.note: Execution happens on accelerator hosts (A800, Hygon K100AI DCU); isolation mechanism not stated, closest value chosen.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: patch framework code, validate correctness, and accept only optimizations that improve the end-to-end serving path
filesystem_access.note: Agent edits framework repositories and builds; no path restrictions described.

network_policy.evidence_quote: It then searches the target framework and reference repositories for adapters, registries, operator dispatch tables, kernel bindings, fallback rules, build flags, and tests.
network_policy.note: No network policy stated anywhere in the paper.

permission_model.evidence_quote: the agent proposes minimal graph edits as code or configuration patches, while the validation framework builds, loads, compares, and serves
permission_model.note: No per-action authorisation described; validation is post-hoc, not gating at emission.

tracing.evidence_quote: E attaches logs, tests, profiles, and accepted measurements
tracing.note: Evidence nodes in the graph plus the search tree constitute structured per-action records.

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: The next step is to build a dedicated benchmark for agentic inference adaptation.
eval_hooks.note: Benchmark is future work; evaluation is three ad-hoc episodes.

guardrails.evidence_quote: Patches follow a conservative engineering discipline: small change sets, explicit tests, dispatch guards, fallbacks, regression checks, and rollback after failure.
guardrails.note: Also invariants: 'must not modify checkpoint weights, model structure, or mathematical semantics'.

target_domain.evidence_quote: MetaInfer, an LLM-agent system for automatic model-hardware co-adaptation of LLM inference frameworks on heterogeneous AI accelerators
target_domain.note: other = inference-framework/kernel systems engineering; involves repository code editing (swe).

primary_artifact.evidence_quote: We present MetaInfer, an LLM-agent system that formulates inference adaptation as route search over a costed execution-adaptation graph.
primary_artifact.note: No repo_url supplied; only the arXiv paper is available.

first_release_date.note: No release/tag exists; basis is the arXiv version date shown (v3, 1 Sep 2026); v1 date unknown.

pinned_version.note: No repository to pin; paper version used.
